title: Runecrafting
wikitext:
{{skl|Runecrafting}} is one of the [[Skills]] available for players to level up by fusing runes, killing [[#Runic Mobs|Runic Mobs]], or by killing [[Boss]]es. It allows the player to fuse [[Runes]] onto their weapons and armor. Runecrafting is a cosmetic-only mechanic, and can only be leveled up to level 3 with the {{Rank|default}} rank.

[[Roman Numerals]] are used to express its levels in-game.

== Mechanics ==
Runecrafting is a cosmetic skill that has content locked to players without a [[Rank]]. '''Players with no ranks cannot increase past level 3 in the skill''', and higher ranks apply a higher exp multiplier. As a "cosmetic" skill no important content or any stats require it to be leveled, and other than some small benefits it may provide (such as tabbed chests) it's purely decoration. The other cosmetic skill is [[Social]].

Each rune has an associated level. The runes can be fused- however, they cannot be activated until the player has their Runecrafting level equal to or greater than the level of the rune.

=== Runic Mobs ===
Runes are obtained from Runic Mobs. Mobs have a {{Chance|0.5%|1|200}} to be Runic. Runic Mobs have a purple name tag, {{Stat|Health|4x}}, and deal {{Stat|Damage|2x}}. When killed, they are guaranteed to drop a [[#List_of_Runes|Rune]].

All mobs can be Runic except [[Ender Dragon]], [[Magma Cube Boss]], [[Slayer]] Boss/Miniboss, [[Dungeon Mobs|Dungeon Boss]], [[Dungeon Mobs|Dungeon Boss Minion]], [[Rift]] Mobs.

Certain runes are also obtained from [[Slayers]] or as special rewards.

=== Fusing Runes ===
Runes can be fused on the [[Runic Pedestal]], found behind the [[Blacksmith]] and owned by the NPC [[Dusk]].

Fusing two runes together will have a chance of upgrading the rune to the next level, up to the maximum level of 3. Upon success or failure, the second rune is consumed. If this process does not succeed, the remaining rune will not gain the level. The chance of success can be seen in the Runic Pedestal while hovering over the apply trigger. Regardless of the outcome, this will also grant Runecrafting experience. More experience is awarded upon success.

Runes can be fused onto [[:Category:Swords|Swords]], [[Bows]], [[Chestplate]]s, and [[Boots]], depending on the type of rune. The player must have their Runecrafting level either equal to or greater than the level of the rune, or they won't be able to fuse it. This only applies to fuse runes to items; runes above the player's Runecrafting level can still be combined together. Fusing runes onto items will also grant Runecrafting experience.

=== Runecrafting EXP Multipliers ===
If you have different ranks on Hypixel, you will get more XP.

*'''Normal''': x1.0, Max level 3
*{{Rank|VIP}}: x1.1
*{{Rank|VIP+}}: x1.25
*{{Rank|MVP}}: x1.5
*{{Rank|MVP+}}: x2
*{{Rank|MVP++}}: x3

== Leveling Rewards ==
{{/Skill UI}}

The cumulative rewards at {{Skl|Runecrafting|Level XXV (25)}} are:
*Access to level 1-25 [[Rune|Runes.]]

== Bugs ==
*Sometimes, {{EnchantmentsLink|Depth Strider}} stops working on boots with a rune. The only workaround is to throw the boots onto the ground and pick it up.
*Players with the {{Rank|Default}} rank are still able to gain {{Skill|Runecrafting}} XP beyond level 3 from killing runic mobs.

== Trivia ==
*This skill was supposed to be released July 16, 2019, but was delayed to August 2, 2019, due to the need for more testing.
*If a player with the {{Rank|Default}} rank manages to reach {{Skill|Runecrafting|4}} or above (e.g. from the above mentioned bug, or having their rank removed by Hypixel Support), they are able to use perks of the higher levels.
**However, any player with the {{Rank|Default}} rank who has {{Green|435}} or more {{Skill|Runecrafting}} XP is generally automatically reset to {{Green|275}} XP within an hour.
<!--*The glitched runes appeared from the original hour of the '''Runecrafting''' release date, they are most likely made unusable since every enemy dropped a Blood Rune. [need more info, what is this referencing?] -->
*The Tidal Rune is the only '''Rune''' that is in bold font.
*The Jerry Rune and the Grand Searing Rune are the only '''Runes''' that are only available in the 3rd tier.
*The Fiery Burst Rune is currently the only '''Rune''' that can be applied to Hoes.
